about.title: About the Atlas
about.description: Atlas of Today’s World is an independent encyclopedia of the present, built around an interactive 3D globe.
about.whoText: {legalName}, a registered association (spolek) under Czech law, company ID (IČO) {companyId}, {address}. Contact: {email}.

patrons.title: Atlas Patrons
patrons.description: Join Atlas Patrons, our community of supporters, and help build an independent, open-access encyclopedia of today's world.
heroLead: We are **a nonprofit initiative** that is currently being developed **entirely by volunteers**.
By joining Atlas Patrons, our community of supporters, **you can help build Atlas and participate on its development.**

card.label: Make a donation
card.introMonthly: Make a monthly donation of your choice. You can cancel it anytime.
card.otherError: Enter a whole amount in euros.
card.processedBy: All donations are processed by the secure Stripe platform.

benefits.title: Help Us Build Atlas
text: You will contribute to creating this encyclopedia and **help us secure long-term, sustainable and independent operation.**
We aim to make Atlas Patrons our long-term primary funding source.

benefits.title: Receive a Special Newsletter
text: Through the patron-only monthly newsletter, you will receive **internal information about our development** and will **get a chance to participate** on it.
Thus you can provide feedback, vote at polls or attend bigger online meetings.

goal.title: Our Current Goal
goal.name: The Initial Team Professionalisation
goal.lead: **We are currently a team of volunteers.** But we face significant limits of such work.
goal.listIntro: **Partly professionalising our team would enable us to regularly:**
items: negotiate partnerships with various academic institutions, media outlets, NGOs or influencers
seek bigger grant funding to boost Atlas development even further
goal.note: This calculator visualises how far we are from achieving our current goal.

newsletterPage.title: The Atlas newsletter
newsletterPage.description: Sign up for the Atlas of Today’s World newsletter: new entries, data updates and what our editors are working on — about once a month.
newsletterPage.lead: About once a month we send what is new in the Atlas: fresh entries and subtopics, updated data on the map and a look at what our editors are working on.
points: New entries and subtopics as they are published
Data updates and new layers on the globe
Behind the scenes of an independent encyclopedia
newsletterPage.note: No spam and no tracking. Every e-mail has an unsubscribe link.
newsletterPage.off: The newsletter is about to start — check back soon.
newsletterPage.donateText: An open encyclopedia of today’s world is paid for by its readers. A monthly gift of any size keeps it free for everyone.
newsletterPage.editorText: Know a country, a region or an issue well? Join our volunteer editors and help write and review entries.
